title: avena bromoides var. pruinosa
intro: Avena bromoides var. pruinosa, commonly known as oat grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and acting as a natural sedative. The therapeutic actions of oat grass include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its calming effects on the body. The bioactive constituents of oat grass include avenanthramides, beta-glucans, and other polyphenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
